protocol.name: wayluck_picker_unstable_v1

description.summary: asking the user what to share

protocol.description:
How `wayluck pick` (xdg-desktop-portal-wlr's chooser_cmd) asks wayluck for the user's choice of what to share: wayluck shows its picker, the user chooses or cancels, and the answer comes back ready to print for the portal. Nothing is shared by asking: only the user's choice decides.
Unstable: changed in place, without version bumps, until it's frozen.

request.name: pick
request.description: The user picks a monitor, a workspace or a window to share. One picker at a time: while one is open, a new pick is cancelled at once.

request.name: destroy
request.description: If the picker is still open, it closes, as if cancelled.

event.name: chosen
event.description: As xdg-desktop-portal-wlr's chooser_cmd prints it: "Monitor: NAME" (a monitor, or a virtual output showing the chosen workspace) or "Window: ID" (an ext-foreign-toplevel-list identifier). The picker has closed.

description.summary: the user chose nothing (Esc, or the picker closed)
